Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de electrocasnice, electrice și electronice, Dezvoltare de software și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
Miele Tehnica is a subsidiary of Miele & Cie. KG, Germany. We produce electronic components for a wide range of Miele appliances, such as washing machines, tumble dryers, vacuum cleaners, ovens and others. The products Miele offers to its customers set the standards for durability, performance, ease of use, energy efficiency, design and service.
 At Miele Tehnica , we are looking for a passionate and innovative DevOps Specialist to join our IT team and contribute to the development of cutting-edge cloud solutions.
 In this role, you will help design, develop, and implement scalable cloud backend solutions for mobile applications, working in an agile, international environment. You will collaborate closely with architects, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance digital solutions.
 Responsibilities 
Planning, conception and implementation of applications in the area of cloud backends for mobile apps 
Taking on responsible tasks throughout the entire project life cycle, including agile project management, requirements analysis, IT architecture design 
Content and technical development in close interdisciplinary collaboration with the Technical Chief Design Architect and the product owners using agile methods 
Management of internal and external service providers
 Skills 
You have successfully completed a degree in (business) informatics, business administration with an IT focus, engineering or a comparable qualification 
Experience with distributed Java applications based on Spring Boot and MQTT as well as implementation of extensive REST APIs 
Experience in the design and implementation of microservice architectures using a container-based infrastructure 
Sound methodological knowledge in the (agile) software development environment, project management, requirements management 
Affinity for innovation and problem-solving skills 
Good written and spoken English (German is an advantage). 
 If you are looking for a long-term career where your talent is appreciated, then we would love for you to join our team!
